responsibility: This header declares text_art::x_ruler, the layout and rendering abstraction for annotating horizontal coordinate ranges with labels. It defines the ruler’s public API, label direction and label kind enums, and the internal label record used during layout, exposing a component that can size itself and paint themed ruler lines, connectors, and optional bordered labels onto a canvas without overlapping text.
same_name_distinction: Declares the x_ruler type, its enums, label record, and public API for labeled range annotations; unlike gcc/text-art/ruler.cc, it does not contain the layout or canvas-painting logic.
